description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Lena, adding {1}.
Lena dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Lena from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Lena enters the battlefield, creating at least four 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Soldiers, adding {3}.
Repeat.
